title: 第1394章 大公无私第1392章 心魔再起
slug: 看见血条的我选择打爆世界
content_zh:
前有心魔接踵来，后有入侵做牵连。
向前向后都不行，还要忌讳势分散。
色界十八君最后还是决定引出七星度厄道君，让他们也来参上一局。
至于借口随便找找就有了，比如说，欲界魔灾追逐你等而来，化作心魔四处作乱。
我们兄弟虽蒙受无妄之灾，但事有轻重缓急、推责埋怨无益。
值此危机时刻，我们兄弟本该放弃内部纠纷，与你等联手对抗魔劫。
不过你等信不过我们，我们兄弟也信不过你们，不如各守一方互不干扰，事后再论你我之事。
如此不仅能占据道德高地，将那心魔大劫化为七星引祸，也能顺势彰显格局，迫使七星道君入局应劫。
可惜万般说辞都不错，能以小义感大德，但局势的复杂严重超出了色界十八君的预料。
当他们暂时放弃心魔纠缠，一同前往色界玄明恭庆乡，呼唤七星度厄道君出山时，竟然发现旧日对手走失了。
“坏了，入侵观明端靖乡的人，该不会是七星度厄道君吧？”
“很有可能，传信不通、一界封禁，七星度厄尤善此道。”
“福祸相依、倒也不错，如此看来心魔大劫的威势极其有限，并不能四处波及层层分化。”
忽闻噩耗，色界十八君非但不慌，反而颇为欣喜。
实力不定、势力不明的心魔大劫固然十分麻烦，但知根知底的七星道君就好处理多了。
届时不管是分兵两路，还是嫁祸污名，皆能从容应对此次劫难。
计策既定，色界十八君立刻赶赴观明端靖乡确认情报，再见七星身影时大义凛然斥魔障。
“欲界魔灾追逐你等而来，化作心魔四处作乱。
我们兄弟蒙受无妄之灾，还思救助你等共度难关，不想你等为心魔所用，不思安守还要纵乱，实在太令人失望了。”
“不好，心魔已得势，代替十八君，我们行事还是晚了一步，致使色界沦陷了。”

“···，我们是真的。”
乱了，全乱了，色界十八君说七星道君被心魔所迷，七星道君言十八君被心魔代替。
谁是真的、谁是假的再也难说清。
好似天下尽是心魔局，又像心魔做变数，两方皆生乱。
不得已之下，色界十八君只能分为两队，一队十四人压制七星道君，另一队四人提防心魔作祟。
看得出来，墨丸给他们的压力不大，善于杀伐的七星道君更为值得他们严加防范。
一时身在无极昙誓乡的贪墨组合压力大减，贪吃墨丸也终于能摆脱挨打、昂首为蛋了。
可即便如此，墨丸也没有大意，反而吸取之前的经验，透过重重迷雾看到了事情真相。
“罗睺，我懂了。
他们定是在引诱我莽撞出击，待到争斗焦灼时再突然现身围剿。
可惜了，区区小计岂能令我落网，机智如我早已堪破真相。”
“你又懂什么了，他们分明是看不上咱们，调集更多的力量去压制另一个变数了。”
“啊，你怎么知道的？”
content_en:
In the past, inner demons came one after another, and in the later, there were invasions to implicate.
It is not possible to move forward or backward, and it is also important to avoid spreading the momentum.
The Eighteen Lords of the Color Realm finally decided to invite the Seven-Star Due Dao Lord to let them participate in the game.
As for excuses, you can just look for them. For example, demons from the realm of desire are chasing you and turning into inner demons to cause chaos everywhere.
Although our brothers suffered unreasonable disasters, we have to prioritize things and it is useless to blame and complain.
At this critical moment, we brothers should have given up our internal disputes and joined forces with you and others to fight against the demonic calamity.
But you can't trust us, and our brothers can't trust you either. It's better to just stick to our own side and not interfere with each other, and then discuss our affairs later.
In this way, not only can they occupy the moral high ground and turn the inner demons into seven stars to cause trouble, but they can also take advantage of the situation to show the pattern and force the seven-star Dao Lord to intervene in the disaster.
It's a pity that all the words are good, and small righteousness can be regarded as great virtue, but the complexity of the situation seriously exceeds the expectations of the Eighteen Lords of the Sex Realm.
When they temporarily gave up the entanglement of their inner demons and went to Xuanming Gongqing Township in the Color Realm together to call the Seven-Star Du'e Dao Lord to come out of the mountain, they unexpectedly found that their old rival had gone missing.
"Oh no, the person who invaded Guanming Duanjing Township couldn't be Lord Qixing Du'e, right?"
"It is very possible that the communication is blocked and the world is blocked. Qixing Du'e is particularly good at this."
"It's not bad that blessings and misfortunes depend on each other. From this point of view, the power of the inner demon catastrophe is extremely limited and cannot affect all levels of differentiation."
Suddenly hearing the bad news, instead of panicking, the Eighteen Lords of the Sex Realm were quite happy.
The catastrophe of inner demons with uncertain strength and unknown power is certainly very troublesome, but it is much easier to deal with it if the Seven-Star Dao Lord knows the basics.
At that time, whether it is dividing the troops into two groups or framing the blame, they will be able to deal with the disaster calmly.
The plan was finalized, and the Eighteen Lords of the Color Realm immediately rushed to Guanming Duanjing Township to confirm the information, and when they saw the figure of Qixing, they righteously denounced the devil.
"The demonic disasters from the world of desire are chasing you, turning into inner demons and causing chaos everywhere.
Our brothers have suffered unreasonable disasters, but we still want to help you and get through the difficulties. We don't want you to be used by your inner demons, and you don't want to stay safe but want to cause chaos. It's really disappointing. "
"No, the inner demon has gained power. Instead of the Eighteenth Lord, we acted a step too late, resulting in the fall of the world of sex."
"..., we are real."
It's chaos, it's all chaos. The Eighteen Lords of the Color Realm said that the Seven-Star Taoist Lord was bewitched by the inner demon, and the Seven-Star Taoist Lord said that the Eighteenth Lord was replaced by the inner demon.
It’s hard to tell who is real and who is fake.
It seems that the world is full of inner demons, and like the inner demons are acting as variables, both sides are in chaos.
As a last resort, the Eighteen Lords of the Color Realm can only be divided into two teams. One team of fourteen people suppresses the Seven Star Dao Lord, and the other team of four people guards against the inner demons.
It can be seen that Mowan puts little pressure on them, and Qixing Taojun, who is good at killing, is more worthy of their strict precautions.
For a time, the pressure of Tan Mo's group in Wuji Tanshou Township was greatly reduced, and Tan Chi Mowan was finally able to get rid of being beaten and keep his head high.
But even so, Mowan was not careless. Instead, he learned from his previous experience and saw the truth of the matter through the fog.
“Rahu, I understand.
They must be tempting me to attack rashly, and then suddenly appear to surround me when the fight is getting intense.
It's a pity that a mere little plan could not catch me. As clever as I am, I can already figure out the truth. "
"What do you know? They clearly look down on us and mobilize more power to suppress another variable."
"Ah, how did you know?"
